description: React component for customizing and sharing theme colors in Mattermost user settings, including color pickers, theme export/import, and style section toggles.

classes.name: CustomThemeChooser
classes.description: React component for selecting, copying, and importing custom themes in user settings.

methods.name: handleColorChange
methods.description: Handles color change for theme settings and updates theme state.

methods.name: setCopyTheme
methods.description: Creates a JSON string copy of the theme excluding type and image properties.

methods.name: pasteBoxChange
methods.description: Handles pasting theme JSON from clipboard and updates theme accordingly.

methods.name: onChangeHandle
methods.description: Stops propagation of change events in textarea.

methods.name: selectTheme
methods.description: Selects all text in the theme JSON textarea.

methods.name: toggleSidebarStyles
methods.description: Toggles the sidebar styles section open/closed.

methods.name: toggleCenterChannelStyles
methods.description: Toggles the center channel styles section open/closed.

methods.name: toggleLinkAndButtonStyles
methods.description: Toggles the link and button styles section open/closed.

methods.name: toggleSection
methods.description: Toggles the open class and overflow style for a section element.

methods.name: onCodeThemeChange
methods.description: Updates theme with selected code syntax highlighting theme.

methods.name: copyTheme
methods.description: Copies theme JSON to clipboard and shows success message.

methods.name: showCopySuccess
methods.description: Displays a temporary success message after copying theme JSON.
